data.title: Introduce yourself
data.prompt: Tell the community who you are, where you live and one thing you love doing. Write at least three sentences in your target language.
data.hint: Start simple: your name, your city, one hobby. Short and correct beats long and messy.

data.title: Your morning
data.prompt: Describe what you did this morning, step by step, from waking up to leaving the house.
data.hint: Use time words: first, then, after that. Present or past tense is fine.

data.title: A place you love
data.prompt: Describe a place that makes you feel at home. What does it look like, sound like and smell like?
data.hint: Try to use at least three adjectives you learned this week.

data.title: Dinner tonight
data.prompt: What are you eating or cooking tonight? Explain it as if you were telling a friend on the phone.
data.hint: Food words stick best when you attach a real memory to them.

data.title: Ask the community
data.prompt: Ask one real question you are curious about and invite native speakers to answer it.
data.hint: Real curiosity gets real answers. Avoid yes or no questions.

data.title: A small win
data.prompt: Share one small thing that went well this week and why it made you happy.
data.hint: Use because and so to connect your ideas.

data.title: Change my mind
data.prompt: Share a mild opinion you hold, for example about food, travel or music, and give two reasons for it.
data.hint: Opinions need connectors: however, because, in fact.
